steps.title: Inspect belt and door path
steps.body: Access ACU. Check drum belt. Door closed: 0–2 Ω J7-3 (L1) to J7-5 (door). Motor path J7-1 to J7-3: 1–6 Ω = OK at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access ACU. Check drum belt. Door closed: 0–2 Ω J7-3 (L1) to J7-5 (door). Motor path J7-1 to J7-3: 1–6 Ω = OK at ACU.

steps.title: Door switch J7-3 to J7-5
steps.body: Door closed: 0–2 Ω across J7-3 (black) and J7-5 (blue).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Door closed: 0–2 Ω across J7-3 (black) and J7-5 (blue).

steps.title: Motor circuit at ACU
steps.body: J7-1 to J7-3: 1–6 Ω indicates acceptable motor circuit path at ACU.

branches.label: Out of spec

branches.oemOutcome: Motor circuit OK at ACU — replace ACU if still no run.

steps.title: Access drive motor
steps.body: Check thermal fuse (TEST #4b). Release belt from pulley. Disconnect motor white connector; remove bare copper from pin 5.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check thermal fuse (TEST #4b). Release belt from pulley. Disconnect motor white connector; remove bare copper from pin 5.

steps.title: Main winding pin 4–5
steps.body: Lt blue pin 4 to bare copper removed from pin 5. Spec 3.1–3.8 Ω.

steps.title: Start winding pin 4–3
